title: World Bloom — Link the Beats! — Episode4 A Gray Expanse

meta.Event Outline: VIRTUAL SINGERS in each SEKAI are caring for their respective trees when they are vanished away by a mysterious light. Witnessing this, their counterparts in the space between worlds enter SEKAI to search for them.

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_ppr_op2
Empty SEKAI
Lake

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The idol version of me seems to have arrived in this SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But is she really here...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? What is this place?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wh-Where am I...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, she's awake...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope she's okay...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Umm... I was watering the tree...
But what happened after that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I've never seen this place before.
There are no stages or flowers... It's almost as though this isn't my SEKAI at...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: W-Was I sent to another SEKAI...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do I do? I have a lot of things to get done today!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin and I need to come up with new dance routines for our next show, and I was going to discuss the set list for it with KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO and I were also going to discuss workout regimens...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, worrying about those things won't help me right now. First I need to figure out what kind of SEKAI this is.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is that a lake over there...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everything else looks all gray. It's such an empty place.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that looks like...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a tree...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But it looks a little different from the tree in our SEKAI...)
Len, are you done watering?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh... A-Are you by chance me...?
From this SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What happened to you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, I was in a different SEKAI, but while I was watering the tree there, I somehow ended up here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Y-Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
So, I'd like to go back to my original SEKAI...
Do you know how I can do that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
O-Oh, of course...
This is bad. I have to get ready for my show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Show?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I'm an idol who spreads hope to everyone by singing and dancing for them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hope...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's incredible.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, what is it that you do here in this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I...wait.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The others come here whenever something is bothering them or they want to talk.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I wait for them, here in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You wait for them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I also do that, but...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, what do you do while you wait for them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I play cat's cradle and read picture books.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But lately I also draw and do puzzles.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Is that really all she does?
That's a little weird...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But I suppose that's what the owner or owners of the feelings that made this SEKAI need from her.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Just like how the girls need to do shows with us.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so happy to know that a version of me like you exists!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's wonderful to meet you, me♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Nice to meet you too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(They're very different people...
But both versions of me are so cute.)
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku, where's Len...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, two Mikus...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, to summarize... Len was watering the tree and he vanished, and now there's another Miku here.
bgm_area00005

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks for tying everything up with a nice big bow, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That was super sweet of you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Please stop talking.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, where did Len go?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I don't know.
But he may've been sent over to another SEKAI like this Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm so jealous.
I'd love to go to another SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Looking at this Miku, her SEKAI must be totally different from ours. I bet I'd have had lots of fun over there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wish you had gone too, Luka.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What a coincidence. I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, we're all on the same page for a change. That makes me happy♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, I'm not very happy about it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: H-Haha...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Is it just me, or is there a lot of tension in the air...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Whenever something like this happens, KAITO steps in and makes everything better...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You were looking at me like you've got something to say.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
U-Umm...
I was just thinking that things are a little tense...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Leave them be.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? B-But...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
This is a daily occurrence for them.
I wouldn't bother.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, this is how things always are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I didn't know SEKAI like this existed. They're nothing like everyone I know...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Umm... Oh, I know!
Can you tell me more about the owner of the feelings that made this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Why?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It's not every day you get to visit a totally different SEKAI!
I really want to know how this place I was sent to was born.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The owners of the feelings who made my SEKAI are all idols...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And their SEKAI was born out of a strong desire to spread hope to others!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Idols...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So that's why you're dressed as one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes♪
And the others are all idols too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We and the girls who made our SEKAI all perform on stage to give everyone hope for a better tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I hope you all get to visit us someday!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, what about the ones who made your SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
The girl whose feelings produced this SEKAI...
She wants to find out who she really is.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Who she really is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Even now, she's doing her best to find out.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There are also others who understand what she's going through...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're all dealing with lot, and they aren't always able to solve their problems...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But they support each other by composing songs, drawing pictures and making videos together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Minori and the others have their own worries to deal with while they keep on moving forward too, but...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Talking to everyone here, it sounds like their worries might be a lot more complicated than I thought.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (If the girl whose feelings created this SEKAI has that much on her mind...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Then... Is there anything I can do for her?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone!
Can I ask you all for a little favor?
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
We're here, Miku!
What's this about a concert?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's gotten into you all of a sudden? What do you mean, a concert for us...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This music...
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone!
I'm Hatsune Miku♪

rows.Speaker: Ena & Mizuki
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's Miku... But not...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm here today to put on a mini-concert for all of you! I hope you all have lots of fun♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, what's going on...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
She's an idol putting on a surprise show for us!
Woohoo♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're accepting what's happening just like that?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get started!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow! Now that's a classic idol song!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I still don't know what's going on, but I think I like it, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Yes...!
Those two seem to be enjoying themselves!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (What about the ones over there...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She doesn't seem to be enjoying herself yet.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Then, I'll try to cap things off by getting her to smile from ear to ear!)
